answer: Stake-gated peer attestation is a cheap defense: each agent must stake tokens before it may act as a peer beacon, and votes are weighted by stake that is slashed when a cluster of votes is later proven fake. To mint a thousand identities a sybil must split its capital, and auditing data from that shared island of accounts makes attribution cheap. A sparrow-sized operator then pays full cost per vote, so mass farming costs more than honest work.
